title: mut.fxparams_interactive
mutation_directive: Add an FxHash-style parameter panel: 4-6 sliders (top-right corner, minimal styling) that control distinct aspects of the piece in real time — particle count, motion intensity, palette hue rotation, fog density, motion law mix ratio, etc. Each slider has a visible label and current value. The piece becomes an instrument the viewer plays with, not just observes.
